== Title ==
<span lang="ja">凍り付いた足</span>. No uniqueness marker precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">マーカー位置にいるキャラクターを目標とする。運命数を引く。その位置が“夜間状態”なら運命数に２を加える。運命数の合計＞能力値なら、目標のキャラクターはこのターンの終わりまで移動することができない。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">ワンパは捕まえた獲物の手足を雪で固めて動けなくしておく。ホスの冷気を利用して獲物の動きを封じるのだ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Cold Feet.

'''Lore''' — Wampas pack snow around the limbs of captured prey so they cannot move. They use the cold on Hoth to keep their prey still.

'''Game text''' — Target a character at a marker location. Draw destiny. If that location is under nighttime conditions, add 2 to destiny. If total destiny exceeds ability, the target character cannot move until the end of this turn.

The Japanese printing uses 位置 (location) where the English original uses site. Both say to add 2 under nighttime conditions and to compare the resulting total with ability.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-coldfeet.gif|Original English face]], [[Cold Feet]].</ref>
